example.Supporting (parent) charts: one-minute, three-minute, five-minute, ten-minute, fifteen-minute and thirty-minute
example.Profit target: equal to the initial risk (1 to 1)
example.Stop: Beyond the setup's swing extreme plus 1 tick
example.Trades per day: one position at a time, no daily limit
example.Daily close: All positions closed by 3:55 PM Chicago on every trading day (earlier on shortened days). A trading day runs from the 5:00 PM Chicago reopen, so a position may stay open past midnight inside one trading day; none is held through the daily close, a closed market or a weekend
example.Exit rule: Half exits at the target (1R); the stop of the rest moves to the entry price and it is held to that stop or the daily close
example.Position size: 10 x Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100 (MNQ) per trade, $0.514 per contract per fill
example.Signal source: E-mini Nasdaq-100 (NQ) one-minute candles (the strategy study's own data)
example.Execution prices: E-mini Nasdaq-100 (NQ) recorded exchange trades used as a proxy for micro fills; no micro trade data was used (disclosed limitation)
